references.text: The Lord speaks to Moses about taking vengeance on the Midianites, which is the direct follow-up to the command beginning in Num 25:16-18.
A similar introductory formula where the Lord speaks to Moses, a recurring pattern throughout the book of Numbers.
The same formula is used when the Lord gives Moses instructions, showing the established pattern for divine communication.
The standard formula 'The Lord spoke to Moses and said' that introduces divine commands in the Torah.
